verdict.rationale: Productboard has an official MCP server product page describing agent connectivity for actions like adding features, rescheduling initiatives, updating custom drivers, and accessing product specs from coding/AI agents. This is first-party vendor documentation confirming the axis is delivered, though there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of setup or reliability. Missing for 10: independent verification or hands-on testing of the MCP server, and detailed setup/auth documentation.
